Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,2)) AS Total_Loss_Payments,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,2)) AS Total_Loss_Reserves,
    CAST(SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS Total_Premium,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(
            (
                SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) +
                SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END)
            ) / SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0))
            AS decimal(18,4)
        )
    END AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;
